name: Tool — Azure AI Search
summary: AzureAISearchTool against a customer-owned search index, attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: Verified live 2026-07-15: attaching AzureAISearchTool to a Prompt Agent whose orchestrator model is BYOM-prefixed works end-to-end — the search tool executes against the customer's index and returns results to the model. Skips if AZURE_AI_SEARCH_CONNECTION_ID or AZURE_AI_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME is unset.
notes:
BYOM works; the tool has no model parameter, but the SDK shape is easy to get wrong.

Use `AzureAISearchTool(azure_ai_search=AzureAISearchToolResource(indexes=[AISearchIndexResource(project_connection_id=..., index_name=..., query_type=..., top_k=...)]))`.

The older kwargs-style constructor (`connection_id`, `index_name`) does not exist in `azure-ai-projects`.
